{{Quote|For over a century, generation after generation, we have kept ourselves isolated here, imbuing ourselves with the energy of the dark side! We are its children!|Gerlun|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 27">[[Legacy (2006) 27|''Legacy'' (2006) 27]]</ref>}}
'''Malevolence''' was a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|practitioners]] who resided on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]], in the dilapidated [[Andeddu's Keep|fortress]] of the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Andeddu]]. The cult survived for thousands of years after Andeddu's death.

Originally recruited by Darth Andeddu to serve as his disciples, the cultists secluded themselves in Andeddu's Keep after his death, studying and harnessing the power of the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They had sent some of their members out to recruit new guardians to replace those who died of age while waiting for their master's resurrection.<ref name="LECG" /> Owing to Prakith's isolation from the galaxy after the expiration of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lane]] leading to the planet, the cult's existence remained largely unknown to the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], until [[137 ABY]], when chief lieutenant of the [[One Sith]] Order, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Wyyrlok III]] arrived.

==History==
In [[980 BBY]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the last surviving [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] after the [[New Sith Wars]], visited Prakith to retrieve [[Holocron of Heresies|Andeddu's holocron]], which, as he had learned from an ancient manuscript, contained [[Essence transfer|the secret of immortality]]. At the time, the inhabitants of Prakith appeared to be very apprehensive towards the cult, as a local treated Bane with hostility after he revealed that he was looking for them. The Dark Lord killed many cultists, and took the holocron back to his [[Darth Bane's mansion|home]] on [[Ciutric IV]].

In [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok III]] [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Wyyrlok)|came]] to the planet. At least eight of the members of the Malevolence fell victim to Lord Wyyrlok's [[Mind trick/Legends|illusions]], which made them see each other as their enemy. Only their leader [[Gerlun]] was spared by Wyyrlok, only to be drained of his life force by [[Holocron of Heresies|Darth Andeddu's holocron]].

The Malevolence cultists attempted to deny the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] Sith Lord entry, but when Wyyrlok displayed his superior mastery of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith abilities]], many of the present cultists were defeated, and [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The sole surviving cultist, [[Gerlun]] (who killed his own brother, [[Demtri]], in the confusion), respected Wyyrlok's power and swore allegiance to him, leading the Sith Lord further inside their domain. However, Gerlun seized an opportunity to betray Wyyrlok when he stole from him the [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] of Lord Andeddu. Unbeknownst to Gerlun, Andeddu's holocron was a key to reviving the ancient Sith's body; it drained his life force and with it reanimated Andeddu's corpse. With Gerlun's death, the Malevolence cult was no more.

Their [[Sith training|training]] in the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] included the use of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], and the construction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].
